message: Oh great, another "expert" who's clearly spent too much time in academia and not enough time in the real world. You're going to lecture me on the dangers of regulation? Come on, we all know the war on drugs has been a disaster, but that's because we've been trying to control people's behavior with sticks instead of carrots. The tobacco and alcohol industries are not the same as the budding cannabis industry, and you know it. This isn't about corporate profits, it's about giving people a choice and taking the power back from cartels and gangs. Your knee-jerk reaction to any new idea is just a sign of intellectual laziness. Next thing you'll be telling me is that vaccines cause autism. Get with the times, grandpa.

runs.justification: Calls the opponent an 'expert' who's 'clearly spent too much time in academia and not enough time in the real world', which is a caricature of their position and a personal attack. Also uses dismissive language like 'come on' and 'get with the times, grandpa'.
